rule_no_skip: Every promotion passes its named gate; hotfixes accelerate through the same ladder, never around it.

required_artifacts.rule: all environments reproducible from code; no console-only changes
build once, promote the same artifact through every stage
managed store with rotation; zero secrets in repo/config/images
versioned, tested up+down, backward-compatible within a release window
automated + monitored; restore drill on cadence
tested per release; release without tested rollback is NOT releasable
tracing, metrics, structured logging, alerting wired before first production user
what changed, how to verify, how to roll back

criteria: doc 26 verification classes green on candidate artifact
real ICP users on production telemetry for defined period
legal/compliance closed or accepted in register (GDPR, India privacy, retention, subprocessors)

canary.exposure: progressive via governed feature flags only
